title: Dog house
description: A little red kennel with a slate pitched roof (ridge along z), white corner boards and ridge cap, an arched dark doorway in a white frame facing +Z with a yellow name plate above it, on a wooden skid base; a steel food bowl with kibble sits in front. Static scenery.
checks: FRONT tile: a gable end with an arched dark doorway in a white frame and a yellow name plate above it
3/4 tile: red walls, a two-sided slate roof overhanging the walls, a steel bowl of kibble on the ground in front to the left
LEFT tile: the kennel stands on the grid line (skid base), the bowl in front of the front end
TOP tile: a plain roof with a white ridge down the middle along z
